message: Astra: Within your odor-study analysis, what evidence supports “Improvements such as recall accuracy and response times were noted,” separately from the uncertain percentages? Does your revision change which claims are supported, or only how confidently they sound? Would more thought about the available source clarify that distinction enough to justify its time, or would a revised statement now be more informative? What unresolved uncertainty would make thinking longer preferable? Which next step can you carry out here, and how will you check its claims against the evidence actually available?
speaker: Astra
